FIMP.description: Inelastic Material Property (FIMP). MATL_TYPE (CONC or STEEL) and HYS_MODEL together select which child object under CONC or STEEL carries the model parameters.

HYS_MODEL.description: Hysteresis model. Case-insensitive. Concrete: KPM, JCSSM, JRSM, NHCM, TCM, GBCHINA, MANDER, JRSMH24, GBCHINA2010. Steel: MPM, BM, UBSM, TSM, PM, JRSM_S, GBCHINA2010_S, ENRGDSPT.

CONC.description: [MATL_TYPE=CONC] Concrete hysteresis model data. Exactly one child object matching HYS_MODEL is used.

EC1_METHOD.description: Descending-branch input selection. 0: use ec1; 1: use Z.

STRENGTH_AFTER.description: Strength after critical strain (ecu) property code.

SIGMA_SY.description: Yield strength of confinement steel sigma_sy.

STRENGTH_LIMIT.description: Strength after critical strain property code.

EPSILON_CU.description: Ultimate strain for confined concrete epsilon_cu.

STRENGTH_AFTER.description: Strength after critical strain property code.

TRILIN.description: [HYS_MODEL=TCM] Trilinear concrete model. INPUT_METHOD selects whether EPSILON_Y_ITEMS or K_ITEMS is used.

INPUT_METHOD.description: Input method. 0: sigma-epsilon (use EPSILON_Y_ITEMS); 1: sigma-alpha (use K_ITEMS).

EC.description: Strain at peak compressive stress epsilon_c.

ET.description: Strain at peak tensile stress epsilon_t.

SC_REBAR_TYPE.description: Section & confinement rebar type. 0: Rectangular; 1: Circular-Hoop; 2: User Defined; 3: Circular-Spiral.

OPT_ACC.description: Use user-input Area of Effective Concrete Core (Acc).

OPT_AE.description: Use user-input Total Area of Effectively Confined Core Concrete (Ae).

AE.description: Total area of effectively confined core concrete (Ae).

OPT_FL.description: Use user-input effective lateral confining stress (circular).

FL.description: Effective lateral confining stress on the concrete (circular) f'l.

OPT_FCC.description: Use user-input strength of confined concrete (fcc).

OPT_EPSILON_CC.description: Use user-input strain for confined concrete (ecc).

EPSILON_CC.description: Strain for confined concrete corresponding to fcc (ecc).

OPT_EPSILON_CY.description: Use user-input yield strain for confined concrete.

OPT_ENABLE_EPSILON_CU.description: Enable ultimate strain for concrete group.

USE_RHO_S.description: Use user-input ratio of the volume of transverse reinforcement (rho_s).

RHO_S.description: Ratio of the volume of transverse confining steel (rho_s).

IDX_STEEL_MATERIAL.description: Steel material key/index used for ultimate strain of confined concrete.

USE_EPSILON_CU.description: Use user-input ultimate strain for confined concrete (eCU).

OPT_EPSILON_CY.description: Use user-input yield strain for unconfined concrete.

OPT_EPSILON_SP.description: Use user-input spalling strain for unconfined concrete.

IDX_EC.description: Elastic modulus of concrete type. 0: Mander et al.; 1: User Input.

IDX_FT.description: Tensile strength of concrete type. 0: Mander et al.; 1: User Input; 2: Neglect Tensile Strength.

FIELD_2.description: Section geometry and reinforcement detailing data for the Mander model.

nRectSectAutoorUser.description: Rectangular section data input type (0: Auto; 1: User Input).

nCircSectAutoorUser.description: Circular section data input type (0: Auto; 1: User Input).

dXdirectionbc.description: Concrete core dimension to center lines of perimeter hoop in y-dir (bc).

dXdirectionwxi.description: i-th clear transverse spacing between adjacent longitudinal rebars in y-dir (w'yi).

nXdirectionn.description: Number of transverse rebar in y-dir (n).

dYdirectiondc.description: Concrete core dimension to center lines of perimeter hoop in z-dir (dc).

dYdirectionwyj.description: j-th clear transverse spacing between adjacent longitudinal rebars in z-dir (w'zj).

nYdirectionm.description: Number of transverse rebar in z-dir (m).

nLongiRebarType.description: Longitudinal rebar type. 0: Rebar Number; 1: Total Area of Rebars.

nGeneralRebarType.description: General confinement rebar type. 0: Rebar Size; 1: Rebar Area.

dGeneralAsx.description: Total area of confinement rebars in y-dir (Asy).

dGeneralAsy.description: Total area of confinement rebars in z-dir (Asz).

bRectStrengthfyh.description: Use user-input confinement rebar yield strength (rectangular).

bGeneralAsx.description: Use user-input total area of confinement rebars in y-dir.

bGeneralAsy.description: Use user-input total area of confinement rebars in z-dir.

bRectRatiopx.description: Use user-input transverse steel volume ratio in y-dir.

dRectRatiopx.description: Ratio of transverse confining steel volume to confined core volume in y-dir (rho_y).

bRectRatiopy.description: Use user-input transverse steel volume ratio in z-dir.

dRectRatiopy.description: Ratio of transverse confining steel volume to confined core volume in z-dir (rho_z).

bRectStressflx.description: Use user-input effective lateral confining stress in y-dir.

dRectStressflx.description: Effective lateral confining stress in y-dir (f'ly).

bRectStressfly.description: Use user-input effective lateral confining stress in z-dir.

dRectStressfly.description: Effective lateral confining stress in z-dir (f'lz).

bCircularStrengthfyh.description: Use user-input confinement rebar yield strength (circular).

bGeneralRebarArea.description: Use user-input area of confinement rebar.

bCircularRatiops.description: Use user-input transverse steel volume ratio (circular).

dCircularRatiops.description: Ratio of volume of transverse confining steel (circular) rho_s.

SIGMA_SY.description: Yield strength of confinement steel sigma_sy.

STRENGTH_LIMIT.description: Strength after critical strain property code.

ECR.description: Strain at peak compressive stress epsilon_c.r.

ETR.description: Strain at peak tensile stress epsilon_t.r.

STEEL.description: [MATL_TYPE=STEEL] Steel hysteresis model data. Exactly one child object matching HYS_MODEL is used.

E2E1.description: Ratio of second slope to first slope E2/E1.

TRILIN.description: [HYS_MODEL=TSM] Trilinear steel model. INPUT_METHOD selects whether EPSILON_Y_ITEMS or K_ITEMS is used.

INPUT_METHOD.description: Input method. 0: sigma-epsilon (use EPSILON_Y_ITEMS); 1: sigma-alpha (use K_ITEMS).

EPSILON_SH.description: Strain at onset of strain hardening epsilon_sh.

EPSILON_ST.description: Strain at onset of strain hardening epsilon_st.

SHAPE_OF_CURVE.description: Shape of curve. 0: General; 1: Perfect Plastic.

FMR_ITEMS.description: Force-moment ratio items (2 rows used: displacement and force).

OPT_USE_TOTAL_STR_LOSS_AT_E.description: Use total strength loss at point E, -E.

OPT_TOTAL_STR_LOSS_AT_E.description: Enable total strength loss at point E, -E.
